title: A Day at Work
content:
Emma is a teacher, but she is not the only professional in her family.

Every morning, her husband Daniel goes to the hospital. He is a doctor and helps many patients every day.

Emma's sister, Sophie, works at a restaurant. She is a chef and loves creating new dishes.

Her brother, Liam, is a police officer. He works in the city and helps keep people safe.

One afternoon, the family meets at a small café.

“Work was busy today,” Daniel says.

“I understand,” Emma replies. “My students had a lot of questions!”

Sophie smiles.

“At least you don't have to cook for fifty people!”

Everyone laughs.

A few minutes later, Liam receives a phone call and quickly leaves.

“Duty calls,” he says.

Emma watches her family and smiles.

They all have different jobs, but they share one thing:

They work hard every day to help other people.

And Emma believes that every profession is important.
